title: A Scurvy of Wonders
author: Rob Dubbin, Courtney Stanton, and Darius Kazemi
description: You play as a person on a yacht who is dying from scurvy. Apparently pursuing a diet of just pizza, chicken fingers, and beer for nearly two months wasn't your best idea. A tiny amount of vitamin C can save you, but you can barely move. And here come the hallucinations.
